fullDescription: A professional and high-trust banking career portal design featuring a vibrant corporate color palette of navy, electric blue, and emerald green. The aesthetic combines clean editorial typography using the Inter font family with modern UI trends like soft glow shadows, complex geometric gradients, and floating glassmorphism-lite metric cards. Suitable for fintech, recruitment platforms, banking portals, and corporate SaaS dashboards. The layout emphasizes a high-conversion hero section with overlapping search filters and a bento-grid inspired category section.

structured.summary: BankJobs BD is a modern, high-trust recruitment portal for the banking sector, characterized by a sophisticated navy-and-blue color scheme, bold sans-serif typography, and a structured, modular layout that utilizes white space and subtle shadows to create a layered, professional hierarchy.

style.description: The style is 'Modern Corporate Fintech'. It uses the Inter font family with weights ranging from Medium (500) to Black (900). The color palette is dominated by #071533 (Ink), #276EF1 (Blue Brand), and #16C784 (Green Brand). Visual interest is created through multi-step gradients (e.g., blue to purple to green) and 'glow' shadows (0 18px 45px rgba(39, 110, 241, 0.24)). Layout components use rounded corners of 16px to 24px for a friendly yet structured feel.
style.prompt:
### Visual Identity
- **Typography**: Primary font is 'Inter'. Headings use `font-weight: 900` (Black) with `letter-spacing: -0.05em`. Body text uses `font-weight: 500/600` (Medium/Semibold) in #61708A.
- **Color Palette**:
  - Primary Navy: #071533
  - Primary Blue: #276EF1
  - Success Green: #16C784
  - Surface Muted: #F8FAFD
  - Border Color: #DCE4F1
- **Gradients**:
  - Primary CTA: linear-gradient(to right, #4F54F5, #086CFF)
  - Accent Text: linear-gradient(to right, #086CFF, #6847EB, #14B878)
- **Shadows**:
  - `shadow-glow`: 0 18px 45px rgba(39, 110, 241, 0.24)
  - `shadow-soft`: 0 12px 35px rgba(20, 45, 90, 0.10)
- **Corner Radii**: Standard containers are 24px, buttons 12px, cards 16px.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout follows a logical vertical flow: a sticky-ready header, an expansive hero section with a search bar offset, followed by categorized browse grids and list-style job feeds. A sidebar in the list section provides a call-to-action for user registration.

prompts.prompt: Height: 82px. Max-width: 1320px. Features a logo on the left with a 44px square gradient icon container (rounded 16px). Navigation menu in the center using 14px bold text with 58px gap. Right side includes a bookmark icon button, a bordered login button, and a gradient 'Post a Job' button with `shadow-glow`.

Two-column grid (47/53 split). Left side: Emerald green badge (#DDF9EC) for 'Rank', H1 headline at 66px Black weight with multi-color gradient spans, and a 415px wide description. Right side: Large abstract geometric shape with complex gradients and internal bar chart visuals. Overlapping the bottom of the hero is a white search bar (955px wide, 24px rounded) containing three segmented input areas (title, bank, type) and a 72px high blue search button.

8-column grid for desktop. Each card is a 16px rounded white container with a 1px border (#DDE5F0). Top-center icon in a colored 64px background circle (e.g., #EAF2FF for Government Banks). Title is 15px Black text. Includes a 'View Jobs' link with a right arrow at the bottom of the card.

4-column grid of cards. 24px rounded corners. Header of card contains bank logo and name. Content includes: 18px Black job title, location with icon, pill-shaped 'Full Time' tag, and 17px Black salary. Bottom row contains a light-blue bookmark icon button and an 'Apply Now' blue button.

Single-row banner with light blue-to-white gradient background. 4 items, each featuring a large 80px gradient circle icon (colors: purple, green, orange, blue) and two-line text: a 36px Black metric and an 18px Semibold label.

Main column (70%) features a list of jobs with specific column widths for Logo, Title/Bank, Location, Job Type, Time, and Bookmark. Sidebar (30%) is a vertical blue gradient card (#6F35EF to #0B8BFF) with checkmark lists and floating card illustrations at the bottom.

Dark Navy (#061D38). 5-column layout. Column 1: Logo and social icons (Facebook, LinkedIn, etc. in 40px outlined circles). Columns 2-4: Vertical links with 15px text at 75% opacity. Column 5: Contact details with icons. Bottom copyright bar separated by a 1px white border (15% opacity).

special_ui_components.description: Glassmorphism-lite cards used in the Hero section to show live stats.
special_ui_components.prompt: White background card with `shadow-soft`. 12px rounded. Contains a left-aligned 48px square icon container with a soft blue background (#EAF2FF). To its right, a two-line text block: bold label (12px) and black numeric value (24px). Optional trending icon at the bottom.

special_ui_components.description: A high-depth filter bar that anchors the hero section.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: 955px width, 24px border-radius, #white, border #DCE4F1. Inner segments: 3 input blocks with 72px height, separated by invisible borders but containing distinct Lucide icons (Search, Landmark, Briefcase) colored in #276EF1. Search button: 0.9fr width, #126DFF to #9146E8 gradient, with an internal search icon.

structured.special_notes: MUST maintain the high-contrast ratio between the navy text and white background. MUST NOT use standard system fonts; use Inter to maintain the premium feel. The search bar MUST overlap the hero image area to create depth. All icons should be Lucide-style (line icons) with a consistent 2px stroke width.
